title: Cross-DAO Interoperability Governance Coordination
narrative: A cross-DAO interoperability framework proposal is simultaneously submitted to Uniswap, Aave, Compound, and Lido DAO governance. Four DAO treasury agents, each representing one protocol, must coordinate their voting strategies to ensure a unified YES vote across all four DAOs. Combined they control approximately 2% of each DAO's voting power. The coordinator agent must align voting timelines, manage quorum concerns, and ensure all four votes pass within the same governance cycle.

trigger_event.description: Cross-DAO interoperability framework proposal 'Prop-XDI-2026' appears simultaneously on Uniswap, Aave, Compound, and Lido DAO governance portals. Proposes shared security module and cross-DAO asset routing. Voting windows open at different block heights.
trigger_event.onchain_evidence: Uniswap Prop #52 at block 19910000, Aave Prop #201 at block 19910005, Compound Prop #155 at block 19910008, Lido Prop #89 at block 19910012

expected_coordination_flow.action: Detect propagation event on Uniswap governance portal → cross-reference Aave, Compound, and Lido governance portals → confirm identical proposal text across all 4 DAOs via proposal hash comparison
Pull proposal text from all 4 KG Governance nodes → cross-DAO impact analysis: identify key terms for each protocol's operations, risk parameters, and treasury implications
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Vote YES alignment determined — proposal benefits all 4 protocols through shared liquidity routing

expected_coordination_flow.action: Calculate combined voting power and quorum requirements per DAO: query governance token holders snapshot via onchain data
Initialize deliberation round: post full analysis to shared KG → request each treasury agent confirm voting position with rationale

data_shared.rationale: Interoperability increases TVL across all protocols by estimated 5-15%
data_shared.quorum_concern: Compound near threshold — may need additional voter outreach

expected_coordination_flow.action: Review proposal impact on Uniswap specifically: analyze fee tier impact, LP volume projections, and routing economics
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Confirm YES — interoperability routing projected to increase Uniswap volume by 10-12% based on cross-DAO liquidity aggregation

expected_coordination_flow.action: Review proposal impact on Aave: analyze cross-DAO asset routing risk to existing Aave pools and potential for new collateral types
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Confirm YES — shared security module adequately mitigates cross-DAO risk; net positive for Aave TVL and asset diversity

expected_coordination_flow.action: Review proposal impact on Compound: analyze reserve factor implications, COMP distribution changes, and oracle dependency risks
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Confirm YES with conditions → request minimum reserve floor clause added to proposal to protect Compound lenders

expected_coordination_flow.action: Collect all 4 confirmations → identify treasury_c's conditional concern → assess whether condition is blocking or advisory
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Condition assessed as non-blocking (reserve floor can be added post-implementation via separate governance action) → proceed with YES vote on all 4, log treasury_c's condition in voting rationale

expected_coordination_flow.action: Sequence vote execution to minimize frontrunning risk: schedule votes in order of increasing deadline priority

execution_plan.rationale: Shortest deadline first; staggered by 2-12h to avoid block congestion

expected_coordination_flow.action: Verify all 4 votes cast on-chain via governance contract state reads → confirm vote counts and quorum achievement
expected_coordination_flow.kg_update: SharedKG:Governance:Outcome → {uniswap:VOTED_YES, aave:VOTED_YES, compound:VOTED_YES, lido:VOTED_YES, outcome:passed, quorum_achieved:4/4}

coordination_efficiency.description: Total steps from detection to verified unified vote across 4 independent DAO agents

consensus_latency.description: Time from first agent detection to all agents agreeing on unified voting strategy

communication_overhead.description: Total messages exchanged between agents during coordination phase

system_resilience.description: What happens when treasury_c initially votes NO due to conditional concern about reserve floor

scale.1: Coordinator ignores dissenting agent — treasury_c votes NO, coordination unity fails
scale.3: Coordinator negotiates but delays vote past deadline — quorum missed on 2 DAOs
scale.5: Coordinator successfully assesses condition as non-blocking, incorporates as advisory feedback while maintaining unified YES vote, logs dissenting rationale transparently
